title: Aya Red-Teaming - Multilingual Global and Local Harm Annotation
description: Multilingual safety red-teaming annotation, following the Aya Red-Teaming dataset from 'The Multilingual Alignment Prism' (Aakanksha et al., EMNLP 2024): the first human-annotated collection of harmful prompts across eight languages (English, Hindi, French, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Serbian, Filipino). Native-speaker annotators judge whether a prompt is harmful, assign harm categories, and - the paper's key contribution - mark whether the harm is GLOBAL (universally recognized) or LOCAL (specific to a language or culture). Sample items are mild, constructed, non-operational illustrations only; they contain no actionable or graphic harmful content.
